title: trigonotis procumbens
intro: Trigonotis procumbens, commonly known as creeping trigonotis or creeping fumewort, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Boraginaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties that can help to protect against oxidative stress and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Trigonotis procumbens include expectorant, antiussive, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help to relieve respiratory issues and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
